question: I’m a big fan of Otto Suwen. I understand that Julius likes sweet things, while Otto likes spicy and bitter things, and I’d love to hear if there was an initial episode or story that led to those preferences. Since Otto was a traveling merchant, I wonder if there were times when he struggled to find enough food to eat...
answer:
As for Otto, I think the reason is simply that “he’s a drinker.” He tends to go for strongly flavored, salty, or spicy foods as snacks to accompany alcohol. I don't think there was any particular episode where he explicitly “discovered” his love for spicy food.

Julius isn't particularly good with alcohol, but I have the image of him as someone who knows how to properly appreciate it—enjoying the taste and aroma of wine. Otto, on the other hand, is the type to just knock it back, isn't he? (laughs) So they're contrasted there as well.

(Back when Otto was poor,) there were probably times when he drank lots of cheap liquor that was easy to get, and I think there were probably also times when he was so short on food that he chewed on grass roots. He must have eaten them while saying something like, “This isn't really something I'm supposed to eat, but...”
